correctness.rationale: The generic permutation extension property realizes every ordered pair of insertion gaps, and homogeneity over the named base identifies each pair with one complete nonalgebraic singleton type. Its grade is the Hamming distance between the two corresponding initial sets. Inversion swaps the Boolean chains, and reversal of either order complements one initial set after reindexing the gaps; thus the generators either keep or reverse the coefficient sequence, preserving unimodality with plateaus. An independently written exact census starts with the gap row d(0,j)=j; when first-order position i is added, d(i+1,j)=d(i,j)+1 for j≤π(i) and d(i+1,j)=d(i,j)−1 otherwise. Checking all possible peak positions found no failures at n=1..9 and 32 among the 3,628,800 permutations at n=10 (4,037,913 checked total). Its independent orbit closure checks that the five representatives are lexicographic minima, that the sizes are 8,8,8,4,4, and that the disjoint union is exactly the observed failures. The reproduced witness profile is (3,8,16,20,19,20,15,8,6,4,2). The n=0 sequence is (1). Appending a largest point in both orders leaves the old grid unchanged and adds two strip positions at each grade 1..n+1 and one joint corner at grade zero. This preserves the strict valley at 3,4,5 indefinitely. Replay from /workspace/branches/b96f0ead-5448-426b-b390-6b5ba9188979: python3 independent_census.py --max-n 10 --output full_results.txt.
residual_risks: The enumeration classifies only lengths through ten; the append proof gives existence, not a classification, for larger n.
